$comment: Per-model builder profile (#938): only the system-prompt variant (current|clean, prompt-variants.mjs), the per-turn tool set (full|subset, turn-tools.mjs), maxTools and textFallback (native tool_calls first; the old text recovery only where this is true). Native tool_calls are always asked for. A choice moves off current/full only on a measured win (tool-harness-probe.mjs; measured.table is rewritten by it). #948: textFallback is off by default for every profile; qwen2.5-coder keeps it on as the sanctioned exception (owner 2026-10-14) until LoRA native calls; remove then.
